projects.title: Your projects

empty.title: Start with a pattern
empty.body: Open a pattern file or try the cable sample. Everything stays on this device.

projects.deleteBody: This project's progress will be removed from the device. The pattern stays.

newProject.title: New project
newProject.intro: Load a KnittingTracker pattern file (.json), recognise a chart from a PDF or photo, or design a pattern from scratch.
newProject.privacy: The file is read on this device only. Nothing is uploaded.
newProject.tooLarge: The file is too large (20 MB limit).
newProject.errors: The pattern has errors – fix the file before you start
newProject.name: Project name
newProject.variantsHint: The pattern stays as it is; changes apply to this project only. Stitch counts stay the same.
newProject.knitOnly: Work chart {{name}} in plain knit stitches
newProject.fromLibrary: Patterns saved on this device are here:
newProject.recognise: Recognise a chart from a PDF or photo

settings.title: Settings
settings.wakeLock: Keep the screen on while knitting
settings.wakeLockHint: Works while a project is open. Some browsers don't support it.
settings.storageMemory: This browser doesn't allow saving data. Progress will be lost when the page closes.
settings.storagePersisted: Data is saved on this device and the browser won't remove it on its own.
settings.storageBestEffort: Data is saved on this device. The browser may remove it when space runs low – keep backups.
settings.privacy: Patterns and progress never leave the device. There is no account and no analytics.
settings.restoreHint: Adds patterns and projects from a backup. Nothing newer on this device is overwritten.
settings.restoreRule: New ones and newer ones in the backup are written with their progress. Newer ones on this device stay as they are.
settings.restoreOrphans_one: {{count}} project skipped: its pattern is missing.
settings.restoreOrphans_other: {{count}} projects skipped: their patterns are missing.
settings.restoreSkipped_one: {{count}} damaged entry in the file skipped.
settings.restoreSkipped_other: {{count}} damaged entries in the file skipped.

sync.local-only: Sync: this device only. To move projects to another device, save a backup and restore it there.

memory.title: Progress won't be saved.
memory.body: The browser blocks saving data (for example in private mode). Open the app in a normal window.

update.available: A new version of the app is ready.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address doesn't lead to any screen.

error.invalid-pattern: This project's pattern can't be opened

tracker.saveFailed: The last change couldn't be saved. It will be retried with the next one.

status.label: Current position
status.nothingYet: Nothing done yet. Tap a stitch to mark it and every stitch before it.
status.counterRows_one: {{count}} row done. Tap “{{button}}” after each row.
status.counterRows_other: {{count}} rows done. Tap “{{button}}” after each row.
status.counterRounds_one: {{count}} round done. Tap “{{button}}” after each round.
status.counterRounds_other: {{count}} rounds done. Tap “{{button}}” after each round.

grid.label: Chart grid
grid.help: Tap a stitch to mark it. Drag to move, pinch to zoom. Keyboard: arrow keys move the cursor, Enter marks the stitch under it.
grid.unsupported: This browser can’t draw the grid. Try a current version of Safari, Chrome or Firefox.

view.title: View
view.rowsStageEnd: To the end of the stage
view.veil: Dim rows above the current one

actions.label: Actions
actions.eraserHint: Eraser: tap a done stitch to go back to it (E)

patterns.title: Your patterns
patterns.intro: Build your own pattern step by step: charts, legend and the round layout. Start knitting it right away or save it to a file.
patterns.addSample: Open the sample in the editor
patterns.deleteBody: The pattern will be removed from this device. Save it to a file first if you want to keep it.
patterns.recognise: Recognise from a PDF or photo

editor.saveError: Not saved – check the fields marked in red
editor.usedByProjects_one: {{count}} project uses this pattern. You'll see your changes there too.
editor.usedByProjects_other: {{count}} projects use this pattern. You'll see your changes there too.
editor.notesHint: Your notes, e.g. needles, yarn, gauge. They stay on this device.
editor.sizesHint: Stitch and row counts can differ per size.
editor.noCharts: No charts yet. Add the first one, e.g. a cable or a rib.
editor.stagesHint: A stage is a part of the work with one layout, e.g. the body in the round, then front and back separately.
editor.legendHint: Enter each symbol's number and description as in your pattern. They're shown next to the grid while knitting.
editor.legendEmpty: Symbols show up here once you draw a chart.
editor.fixFirst: Fix the errors to start a project. You can save to a file any time.
editor.hasGauge: The pattern gives a gauge (10 × 10 cm)
editor.gaugeHint: Used to estimate rows in “knit until X cm” stages. A project can use its own gauge.
editor.continueStageHint: A new stage right after this one with the same layout. Charts continue with the next row; you change the layout (decreases, increases, splitting front and back).

chartEditor.brokenSymbols: This pattern's own symbols are broken. Fix them in the pattern file.
chartEditor.help: Draw: tap or drag over cells. Select: drag to select a rectangle. Two fingers pan and zoom. Keyboard: arrows move the cursor, Shift+arrows select, Enter places the chosen symbol, Delete clears, 1–9 pick a palette symbol, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X and Ctrl+V copy, cut and paste, Ctrl+Z undoes.
chartEditor.whereNone: Tap a cell or use the arrow keys.
chartEditor.selectionHint: Choose “Select” and drag over cells. Without a selection, actions apply to the cell under the cursor.
chartEditor.heading: Chart editor: {{name}}

library.title: Symbol library
library.none: Nothing matches. You can add your own symbol.

symbol.inUse: A chart uses this symbol. Replace it first.
symbol.name: Name
symbol.nameHint: Give it a name, e.g. “bobble” or “k3tog”.
symbol.abbrHint: Up to 4 characters, e.g. B or 3t.
symbol.countsHint: How many stitches you take from the left needle and how many end up on the right one, e.g. k2tog takes 2, makes 1.
symbol.wsText: How to work it on the wrong side

stage.title: Layout: {{name}}
stage.intro: Put the charts in the order of the pattern text, from the start of the round or row. The first segment is the first stitches worked, on the right of the grid.
stage.name: Stage name
stage.roundHint: Every round is on the right side; read the chart right to left.
stage.flatHint: Rows alternate between the right and the wrong side. On the wrong side you read left to right and symbols swap meaning.
stage.firstRow: The first row is on the
stage.hasRows: I know the number of rows
stage.openEnded: No row count: you knit e.g. “until the piece measures 30 cm”.
stage.hasExpected: The pattern states the stitch count
stage.expectedHint: We compare it with the sum of the segments to catch mistakes.
stage.expectedOff: Turn on if the pattern says how many stitches should be on the needles.
stage.layoutHint: E.g. “A.1 over 22 sts, A.2, A.3, marker, …”. A marker splits the round into parts such as front and back.
stage.markerName: Name of the part from this marker
stage.markerHint: E.g. Front or Back. Leave empty for a plain marker.
stage.partialHint: The chart repeats horizontally and the last repeat may be partial.
stage.startColumnHint: Cells counted from the left. You usually start on the right ({{w}}).
stage.startRowHint: When this chart is shifted vertically against the others.
stage.label: Label on the grid
stage.noCharts: Add a chart to the pattern first.
stage.previewEmpty: The preview appears once you add a chart.
stage.previewHelp: Drag to pan. Pinch or use Ctrl and the mouse wheel to zoom.
stage.trackStitches: Every stitch (tap stitches on the grid)
stage.trackingHint: A row counter is enough for simple stitches such as ribbing or stockinette.
stage.targetHint: With a gauge the app estimates the rows. You end the stage yourself with “Finish stage”.
stage.continueRows: Continue as in an earlier stage
stage.continueHint: The chart starts with the row after the last one worked in that stage, e.g. the front after the split continues A.2 of the body.

diag.palette-reserved: {{chart}}: “.” is reserved for the cells of wide symbols.
diag.symbol-truncated: {{chart}}, row {{row}}: the symbol at cell {{col}} from the left needs {{width}} cells.
diag.orphan-continuation: {{chart}}, row {{row}}, cell {{col}} from the left: part of a symbol without its start.
diag.unknown-cell: {{chart}}, row {{row}}, cell {{col}} from the left: unknown character “{{char}}”.
diag.symbol-overflow: {{chart}}, row {{row}}: the symbol at cell {{col}} from the left runs past the chart edge.
diag.start-column: {{stage}}: column {{column}} doesn't exist in chart {{chart}} (it has {{width}}).
diag.stitch-count: {{stage}}: the layout has {{actual}} stitches, the pattern says {{expected}}.
diag.empty-layout: {{stage}}: the layout has no stitches yet. Add a chart.
diag.zone-cuts-symbol: {{zone}}: the repeat over {{stitches}} stitches cuts a symbol {{width}} cells wide (chart row {{row}}).
diag.ws-unsupported: {{zone}}: chart row {{row}} falls on the wrong side, and this symbol has no wrong-side instruction.
diag.chain-wrap: {{chart}}: the top row leaves {{produced}} stitches but row 1 needs {{consumed}}. The chart can't repeat vertically.
diag.chain-break: {{chart}}: row {{row}} leaves {{produced}} stitches but row {{nextRow}} needs {{consumed}}.
diag.flow-cable: {{chart}}, row {{row}}, cell {{col}} from the left: the cable starts on a different kind of stitch than the row below leaves. Check this cell.
diag.flow-texture: {{chart}}, row {{row}}, cell {{col}} from the left: knit/purl change (usually intended).
diag.size-list: {{label}}: {{actual}} values, but the pattern has {{expected}} sizes.
diag.legend-unknown-symbol: The legend refers to unknown symbol {{symbol}}.
diag.continue-unknown: {{placement}} in “{{stage}}” continues the chart rows of “{{source}}”, which has no fixed row count. They are set when you finish that stage in a project.
diag.continue-missing: {{placement}} in “{{stage}}” continues a chart that is not in “{{source}}”. Choose it again.
diag.continue-cycle: {{placement}} in “{{stage}}” continues itself through other stages. Choose another start.

importer.title: Import a pattern
importer.intro: Choose a PDF with charts, or a photo or screenshot of a chart. We'll find the grids, symbols and legend, then check them together with you.
importer.limits: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to {{mb}} MB and {{pages}} pages.
importer.privacy: The file is processed on this device only. Nothing is sent to the internet.

errors.wrong-type: This is not a PDF or an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP).
errors.too-many-pages: The PDF has too many pages. Choose a file with just the charts.
errors.too-many-pixels: The image is too large. Shrink it or crop it to the chart.
errors.unsupported: This browser can't open this image.

importer.straightenHint: Drag the four corners onto the corners of the chart, or tap a corner of the chart in the photo and the nearest handle moves there. For screenshots and scans choose “Don't straighten”.
importer.none: No chart found. Try a sharper photo, or build the chart in the editor.
importer.found_one: Found {{count}} chart. Check it against the original.
importer.found_other: Found {{count}} charts. Check them against the original.
importer.legendHint: Each legend symbol got a library symbol. Correct any that don't match and recognise again.
importer.symbolsHint: The file has no legend. Tick the symbols used in the charts: the fewer, the surer the result.
importer.chartsHint: The original is on the left, the recognised grid on the right. Cells outlined in red are uncertain: tap a cell to confirm or change it.
importer.nameHint: The name from the pattern, e.g. A.1.
importer.allChecked: Every cell was recognised with confidence.
importer.gridHelp: Tap a cell to select it. Arrow keys move the selection, Enter confirms, 1–9 pick a symbol, N goes to the next uncertain cell.
importer.descriptionHint: Sizes and the chart order of a round come from the pattern text. If it is in another file, load it or paste the text.
importer.sizesHint: Separate sizes with dashes, e.g. S - M - L.
importer.stillUncertain_one: {{count}} uncertain cell is left. You can fix it later in the chart editor.
importer.stillUncertain_other: {{count}} uncertain cells are left. You can fix them later in the chart editor.

position.hint: Enter where you are, e.g. after knitting without the app (shortcut: G)
position.title: Where are you?
position.intro: Enter the row you are on and how many of its stitches you have worked (from the start of the row). You can undo this.
position.introCounter: Enter how many rows you have finished. You can undo this.
position.stitchesHint_one: The row has {{count}} stitch to work.
position.stitchesHint_other: The row has {{count}} stitches to work.
position.previewRow: Last done: row {{row}}, stitch {{stitch}} ({{total}} in total).
position.previewRound: Last done: round {{row}}, stitch {{stitch}} ({{total}} in total).

finish.title: Finish “{{name}}”?
finish.partial_one: Row {{row}} is started ({{count}} stitch) and will not count. If it is done, tap “{{button}}” first.
finish.partial_other: Row {{row}} is started ({{count}} stitches) and will not count. If it is done, tap “{{button}}” first.
finish.lastChartRows: Last chart rows worked — check them against the pattern, e.g. “end after an even row of A.2”:
finish.continueHint: Later stages that continue these charts start with the next row. You can undo this (“Reopen stage”).
finish.partialRound_one: Round {{row}} is started ({{count}} stitch) and will not count. If it is done, tap “{{button}}” first.
finish.partialRound_other: Round {{row}} is started ({{count}} stitches) and will not count. If it is done, tap “{{button}}” first.

stagePanel.title: Stage: {{name}}
stagePanel.phaseUnknown: Some charts continue an earlier stage without a fixed row count. Their rows are set when you finish that stage.
stagePanel.estimate_one: About {{done}} of {{target}} cm, about {{count}} row left.
stagePanel.estimate_other: About {{done}} of {{target}} cm, about {{count}} rows left.
stagePanel.noGauge: Enter a gauge in the project settings to estimate rows.

projectSettings.title: Project settings
projectSettings.name: Project name
projectSettings.patternGauge: The pattern says {{stitches}} stitches and {{rows}} rows in 10 cm.
